---

## Hypothesis

What specific mechanism do you expect to improve?

## Falsifiable prediction

What measurable result would count as success?

## Baseline

Which frozen model, benchmark, or experiment is the comparison point?

## Controls

What held-out, negative, or adversarial controls are required?

## Compute budget

What is the smallest pilot that can falsify the hypothesis?

## Acceptance rule

What result is required before scaling?
